title: BlockSit
description: A small 1.21 datapack that adds mini blocks that the player can sit on
body:
# BlockSit
BlockSit is a 1.21 Datapack that adds three mini block options for players to sit on anywhere. These seats are created where the player is currently standing, and is based on the direction the player is facing.

## Commands
BlockSit uses /trigger commands for creating and removing seats.

`/trigger sit` - Opens a menu in chat for players to choose a block to create a seat

`/trigger removeseat` - Removes a seat a player has created

## Operator Commands

`/function blocksit:remove_all_seats` - Removes all seats from the world.
